Universe Manual · Working canon

Creation and Cosmology

Morninghollow is a layered world whose structure and spiritual meaning are part of one unfolding story.

Cubes within cubes

The current canon describes Morninghollow as cubes nested inside larger cubes. The Origin is the centerward reference point, and travel through Morninghollow is always directed toward the center. Dayfall's arena is one region within that greater structure.

The exact mechanism of centerward travel—an attraction, connected geometry, or another rule—is still being developed. The cosmology describes the story world; it does not define Abyssal Engine coordinates or runtime behavior.

The Origin

Center of the structure

The Origin is the central reference point around which the nested structure is organized. Its full role in creation and in the trilogy remains under development.

The Wall

Day and Night

The Wall divides the realms watched by Vry and Voy. The Fall of Man disturbs Morninghollow and breaks the Wall; whether a later explosion creates another breach remains an open continuity question.

The Guardians

Vry and Voy

Vry is associated with Day, and Voy with Night. In Dayfall, the player chooses which side to command before their conflict reaches its decisive confrontation.

The wider setting

A celestial frame

Current concept art places the nested cubes within a celestial sphere. Whether the sphere is a literal boundary or a visual setting is not yet settled.

Creation Theory and the story canon

The existing Creation Theory is part of Keyless Abyss's story history. The Morninghollow Canon Bible records the current nested-cube direction while preserving earlier writing as historical source material. The older page remains available to read.
